name: @kitr/server
description: @kitr/server: the kitr app on h3. Standalone (srvx) or as a fetch handler inside TanStack Start, Nitro or any runtime. No React.

kitr.name: server
kitr.title: Server
kitr.summary: Run a Node server that starts, logs and shuts down cleanly.

platform.label: Node · Bun · Deno
platform.tagline: An HTTP API with routes, controllers and live channels, on Node, Bun, Deno or Cloudflare Workers. With React or without it.

highlights.title: Four runtimes, one option
highlights.text: `runtime: 'bun'`, `'deno'` or `'workers'` changes how `kitr dev` and `kitr build` run the same `server/main.ts`. Workers deploy through `wrangler.toml`.

highlights.title: A client typed from your routes
highlights.text: Routes and controllers live in `server/routes.ts`. The client your pages call is typed from that table, so a renamed field is a type error, not a bug report.

highlights.title: Inside your site or beside it
highlights.text: A project with a web platform also gets `app/routes/api.$.ts`, which mounts the same server inside TanStack Start. Run it there, or as its own process.

highlights.title: No React required
highlights.text: `kitr new my-api --kit server` has no React anywhere in its dependency graph: an h3 server, routes, a database hook, logs and tests.

run: tsx watch, bun --watch or wrangler dev, by runtime

resources.title: h3
resources.text: The HTTP framework the server is built on.
